title: SmartAbp Template Metadata
description: Describes the metadata for a SmartAbp code template.

id.description: The unique identifier for the template, typically the template's filename without extension.

version.description: The semantic version of the template.

name.description: A human-readable name for the template.

description.description: A detailed description of what the template generates and its purpose.

tags.description: Keywords to help categorize and search for the template.

author.description: The author or team responsible for the template.

type.description: The primary language or framework of the template.

placeholders.description: An array of placeholder definitions used in the template.

description.description: A clear explanation of what this placeholder represents.

required.description: Whether this placeholder must be filled.

defaultValue.description: A default value if the placeholder is optional and not provided.

relatedTemplates.description: A list of other template IDs that are commonly used with this one.
